pin.title: Yaba Misen — Matsuzakaya Nagoya Opens in Sakae / Yabacho
pin.description: A new department-store branch of Yaba Misen, with Taiwan ramen and branch-specific curry, tantan noodles and offal chawanmushi.
pin.address: B1F North Building, Matsuzakaya Nagoya, 3-16-1 Sakae, Naka-ku, Nagoya
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Landlord September 17 operator release confirms October 1, 2026 at 11:00. October 1 TV Aichi opening-day reporting confirms actual opening. This is the Matsuzakaya branch, not the Osu main store.
pin.longFormSummary:
A new department-store branch of Yaba Misen, with Taiwan ramen and branch-specific curry, tantan noodles and offal chawanmushi.

Landlord September 17 operator release confirms October 1, 2026 at 11:00. October 1 TV Aichi opening-day reporting confirms actual opening. This is the Matsuzakaya branch, not the Osu main store.

menus.note: Actual branch press-preview printed menus and labelled tasting report, September 2026; published October 10 update. Tax included. HotPepper September 15 pre-opening menu lists conflicting Taiwan ramen ¥850 and greens ¥830 (recommendation ¥790), while the photographed branch menu/report shows ¥950 each. Use the actual branch menu with a price-confirmation note. The HotPepper recommendation and main listing also disagree on offal ramen ¥970/¥1,200; neither is imported as a resolved price. September release prices were undecided. October 1–3 mini-soft-serve giveaway is expired. Complete printed menu photographs are attached with accurate source attribution.

openingHours.hours: 11:00–22:00; last order 21:30; closures follow department store
